content: ## Metadata_Start ## code: en ## title: Configure for Chatter ## slug: configure-for-chatter ## seoTitle: ## description: ## contentType: Markdown ## Metadata_End :::(Info) (**Are you interested in the Blackthorn Compliance-Chatter extension package?**) The Chatter extension package is a paid add-on for Blackthorn Compliance. Please contact your Account Manager to learn more about purchasing it. ::: * * * :::(Warning) (**IMPORTANT UPDATE**) For Compliance - Version 3.87 to work correctly, Chatter - Version 3.73 must be installed. Click [here](https://login.salesforce.com/packaging/installPackage.apexp?p0=04t5w000004GsUCAA0){target="_blank"} to access the Chatter Version 3.73 production link. **Note:** Compliance will continue to work without the additional file; however, the most recent update won’t work. ::: 1. Install the Chatter extension package: * [production](https://login.salesforce.com/?ec=302&startURL=%2Fpackaging%2FinstallPackage.apexp%3Fp0%3D04tf2000000cSRj){target="_blank"} * [sandbox](https://test.salesforce.com/?ec=302&startURL=%2Fpackaging%2FinstallPackage.apexp%3Fp0%3D04tf2000000cSRj){target="_blank"} 2. Turn on Detection for FeedItem. 3. You should see the following alert notification: ![turned on feeditem](https://cdn.document360.io/f977eec0-500f-40a3-b663-724a51f78075/Images/Documentation/turned%20on%20feeditem.png){height="" width=""} 4. Turn on Detection for FeedComment. 5. You should see the following alert notification: ![turned on for feedcomments](https://cdn.document360.io/f977eec0-500f-40a3-b663-724a51f78075/Images/Documentation/turned%20on%20for%20feedcomments.png){height="" width=""} 6. Congratulations! You have successfully configured Chatter for Blackthorn {{variable.Product_Compliance}}. 7. Use the steps below to ensure the {{variable.Field_Chatter_EditPostsComment}} Chatter setting is enabled. (This setting is enabled by default.) 1. Click the **Gear icon** in the upper right-hand corner. 2. Click **Setup**. 3. In the Quick Find box, search for and click "Chatter Settings". 4. Click the {{variable.Button_SF_Edit}} button at the bottom of the page. 5. In the Posts and Comment Modification section, check the {{variable.Field_Chatter_EditPostsComment}} setting. 6. Click {{variable.Button_Save}}. :::(Warning) (**Installing Compliance**) You still need to install Compliance from the Blackthorn {{variable.Link_CandyShop}}, but we will upgrade your existing package to include Chatter support. :::
